integrity: The proof uses the primary source exact projection-energy identity and Fourier convention, identifies its endpoint multiplier with the primitive of mean-zero data, and proves the sharp coefficient by a self-contained arclength Wirtinger plus Cauchy--Schwarz isoperimetric argument. The equality cases are derived from equality in those inequalities. No finite numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is confined to the one-dimensional Hilbertian half-Sobolev model. It does not determine sharp constants for higher-dimensional Hodge estimates, Besov or Triebel--Lizorkin extensions, or nonlinear selection-map norms. The equality classification applies to the frequency-energy imbalance, not to every related selection problem.
title: Sharp isoperimetric constant in the one-dimensional Bourgain--Brezis model
